summary.value: Chelsea Market is the indoor food hall at 75 Ninth Avenue between 15th and 16th Streets.

description.value: Chelsea Market is an indoor food hall and shopping arcade at 75 Ninth Avenue (between 15th & 16th St.). It sits next to the High Line in the Meatpacking District edge of Chelsea. Plan to graze through several food stalls rather than one sit-down meal.
